summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added the "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection to docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and wrote tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Per instructions, I did not run tests or repository code, did not install packages, and did not commit. Line lengths in the new and edited Python files were measured by awk: none exceed 120 columns. Black and flake8 were not run. Choices beyond the spec: a non-object top-level JSON value or a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; items are copied rather than mutated; "test" entries are wrapped before the mapping check.
